## Checks

```sh
uv run pytest && uv run ruff check . && uv run pyright
```

CI runs these on every push and pull request.

## Release

1. Bump `version` in `pyproject.toml`.
2. Commit, tag `vX.Y.Z` and push the tag.

CI checks that the tag matches the `pyproject.toml` version. Config repos made from the template pick up the new tag on their next scheduled check. See [Deploy](deploy.qmd).

Commits are one-line conventional commits.

## Docs

```sh
uv sync --group docs
uv run great-docs preview
```

Building needs [Quarto](https://quarto.org). The site deploys to GitHub Pages on each push to `main`.
